utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the book club. What did you want to sort out first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks — sorry I’m a little late. Could we start with the meeting time and whether we’re picking the next book tonight?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — I’m glad you made it. Yes, let’s decide the meeting time first, then we can pick the next book tonight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the reading list so I don’t mix it up—what book do you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I was thinking of the one we picked for this week—what’s the title on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I can bring extra tea and snacks for book club if you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great, thanks — I’m a little scattered and keep forgetting what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — I’ll make a quick list and keep track of what we still need. You just focus on the books, and I’ll handle the snacks and tea.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d be happy to hear what the book club’s reading next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet, but I can check the schedule and let you know. I just want to make sure we’ve got the right book before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Pia — no rush. Just let me know when you’ve checked the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the next book club pick, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard folks are leaning toward a mystery, but I’m still waiting on the official word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — do you know when they’ll announce it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard this month’s pick is a really good one—everyone’s been talking about it. Want me to pass along the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, that’d be great—thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — it’s this Thursday at 7, over at Marla’s place on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come to book club this week — I’m telling everyone it’ll be a good one!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d love to—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 at my place—I'll send the address right over!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I'm happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just to confirm—you’re still okay helping with the book club, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely—I’m still happy to help with the book club. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Bo — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What book are we thinking of this time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still deciding, to be honest — I skimmed a few ideas but haven’t picked one yet. I’ll send you the shortlist later today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll help you narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be much appreciated, Vik. I like having the plan set ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m a little fuzzy on the details, but I’d be happy to join if you need another person.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind of you, Oren. I’ll let you know the details once I’ve sorted them out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli—just remind me when you’ve got them sorted, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve been hearing good things about the book club lately — what are you all reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery novel this week — I keep hearing people say it’s a real page-turner. I’m planning to pick up my copy later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, that sounds like a fun one — let me know if it’s as twisty as people say!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club? You should come this week — I’ve already told a few folks, and it’s shaping up to be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be late, but I’d love to swing by if there’s room. What book are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, there’s room — we’re reading "The Midnight Library" this week. I’ll save you a spot, even if you’re a little late.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might come by and listen this time. What book are folks discussing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re discussing "The Thursday Murder Club" tonight. If you come by, I’ll point you to the chair by the window and we start at seven.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice—I'll try to make it by seven. The chair by the window sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can work around the school pickup times. What day is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Thursday evening at 7 — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Thursday at 7 works for me — I can make that after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I was just thinking the book club could use one of your great discussion prompts—want to help pick the next read?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing—I can help pick the next read and I’ll bring a discussion prompt too. What kinds of books are we leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking something easy to talk about—maybe a mystery or a character-driven novel. If you’ve got a few favorites, I’d love to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — if the book club needs anything handy, I’ve got a few tools and can help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got everything lined up so the meeting doesn’t turn into a scramble.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I can bring a few basics and help check the setup before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where we’re meeting for book club—just tell me the location and time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s meet at the community room on Maple at 6:30 on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community room on Maple this Thursday at 6:30. I’ll keep that noted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle on the next book, or are we still choosing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t think we settled it yet — I want to double-check the list before we decide.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — want me to bring the list over and we can pick one together?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Cleo — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring extra cups and a few snacks for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring extra cups and a few snacks for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits about the book club, but I’m a little out of the loop — what are people reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think they picked that new mystery novel, though I might be mixing it up with the last one. I should probably check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, no worries — if you see the flyer, could you let me know? I’d love to catch up before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the book club is still happening this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on this week — same time and place as usual.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — it’s still the same time and place, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Uli — did the book club decide on the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I think they’re still deciding. I’ll let you know once they pick one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — just give me a shout when they settle on one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the book club. I’m a bit foggy today, but I’m happy to help however I can!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — can you just bring the meeting notes and the next book suggestion?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring the meeting notes and I’ll think of a good next book suggestion too.
